baseline_policy: Inherit OVAL function semantics unless an explicit traceable SCAP-NG owner decision establishes a difference. No approved deviation was identified for the retained forms in this audit.

retained_forms.name: literal
retained_forms.source_lines: FunctionGroup component model; typed literal component
retained_forms.input_cardinality: one scalar, ordered list, or typed value; record payload is an object
retained_forms.result_semantics: Preserve authored value, order, duplicates, datatype, and explicit record shape

retained_forms.name: variable
retained_forms.result_semantics: Reference preserves the referenced values and evaluation status; reference cycles and type compatibility require semantic validation

retained_forms.name: values
retained_forms.source_construct: Native collected-field composition; no one-to-one OVAL function
retained_forms.input_cardinality: values from the selected collected Object field
retained_forms.result_semantics: Preserve collected multiplicity and provider status; field absence is not silently converted to a literal
retained_forms.approved_deviation: native composition; no approved semantic deviation identified

retained_forms.name: concat
retained_forms.input_types: string-compatible components; inherited OVAL casting expectations apply
retained_forms.result_semantics: Concatenate in component order; multiple-valued components produce Cartesian-product combinations; missing/nonexistent components produce the inherited status; status flags propagate rather than becoming strings

retained_forms.name: regex_capture
retained_forms.input_cardinality: one input expression; each value is processed independently
retained_forms.result_semantics: Use the first capturing group and inherited regex/first-match behavior; no capture or no match yields the source-defined empty-string result

retained_forms.name: unique
retained_forms.input_types: scalar values; record literals are explicitly outside the retained transformation domain
retained_forms.result_semantics: Flatten source populations in order, remove later duplicate values, preserve first occurrence and diagnostic status
retained_forms.approved_deviation: The current native grammar accepts one expression, while OVAL UniqueFunctionType permits one or more components; no owner decision authorizing that narrowing was identified. Widening or preserving this boundary requires semantic review.

retained_forms.name: merge
retained_forms.source_construct: Native composition; no one-to-one OVAL function
retained_forms.input_types: string-compatible values; explicit sort mode and order
retained_forms.result_semantics: Flatten source populations in order, preserve duplicates, apply explicit sort/order, and join with delimiter
retained_forms.approved_deviation: native composition; no approved semantic deviation identified

retained_forms.name: count
retained_forms.result_semantics: integer; duplicates count, successful empty is zero, statuses remain statuses

retained_forms.name: split
retained_forms.result_semantics: literal delimiter; preserve empty parts, duplicates, order and statuses

retained_forms.name: substring
retained_forms.result_semantics: signed 32-bit options and OVAL one-based boundaries; errors/statuses remain visible

retained_forms.name: arithmetic
retained_forms.result_semantics: Cartesian product; add/multiply; integer/float widening; no implicit coercion

retained_forms.name: begin
retained_forms.result_semantics: prepend complete boundary string only when absent

retained_forms.name: end
retained_forms.result_semantics: append complete boundary string only when absent
